newsitem.title: UK: Runaway Scottish bishop to marry lover.
newsitem.headline: Runaway Scottish bishop to marry lover.

text.p: A Roman Catholic bishop who ran away with a divorcee said on Tuesday he is to marry his lover.
Roderick Wright, who was also revealed to have a teenage son by another woman, told the Glasgow Herald newspaper that it would probably be a civil wedding "at a time that is suitable".
His lover, mother-of-three Kathleen Macphee, revealed in another interview with the Daily Mail that they only became lovers after running away together.

The Bishop of Argyll, whose resignation and disappearance three weeks ago rocked the Catholic church, said he would have to accept after 32 years as a priest that he would never stand at an altar again and say Mass.
"Not being a priest is something I'll have to live with if I'm given the peace and time to do so," he said.
Macphee said in her interview that they had now consummated their relationship.
"People can't seem to understand that we could have a loving relationship without sex, but we did," she said.
"I'm not disappointed. I have three children and I think I'm past my sell-by date."
"We want to get married. Roddy told me he wanted to marry me but we haven't set a date."
